artifact.stop_condition: Stop intake at the 60-ticket cap or when the data boundary is unclear; retain only the local synthetic record for owner review.

operator_steps: Open the separately approved local rehearsal build and verify that only synthetic fields are present.
Use authored ticket IDs to practice welcome-to-demo handoff without names or contact data.
Stop intake at the reviewed capacity boundary and ask the owner before changing scope.
At closeout review the synthetic counts and the operating-model retention rule before deleting exercise data.
